answer: Charge each identity a real, recurring cost instead of a one-time signup: like a quill that must be re-inked, an agent's standing is rewritten with every verified job, so a fake cannot rest on a single good deed. Price attestations so a sybil swarm faces a widening delta between what clones cost and what they earn, and anchor reputation in basalt-hard history — work that cannot be faked cheaply — so mass fakery bleeds money while honest agents compound trust.
